دُرْعَةٌ , in a horse, and in a sheep or goat, Blackness of the head, and whiteness [of the other parts]: or, accord. to some, blackness of the head and neck: a subst. from دَرِعَ [q. v.]. (Msb.) ―
-b2- See also أَدْرَعُ, in the middle of the paragraph.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
